items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Gene Carver got me a great job.

ctx.x: Law grab her and went in there and got all that stuff out of front of them. Yeah, Gene Carver got me a great job.

He played about, let me see, he played trumpet, trombone, tenor, piano, and could sing. That guy you stuff like Yeah, Gene Carver, I mean that job. He played about, let me see, he played trumpet, trombone, tenor, piano, and could sing. That guy you talking about. Yeah.
